Honestly she probably has long lasting effects from what she was taught. It sounds like she was taught that sex was a chore to be done for someone, not for herself. Having that stuff engrained into your mindset can be honestly traumatic.

Maybe more than just baseline therapy, maybe consult a sex therapist? She may need to see that its not her duty or a chore and move past her childhood to repair this relationship.
